review_candidates.title: Production Lead Engineer for SaaS Platform
review_candidates.description: About the Role We’re looking for someone to be our point person and incident commander at night — the hours our platform runs but Jester and the daytime team aren’t on. Our platform (Autopilot) helps 2,000+ dental labs worldwide get their cases booked correctly within 15 minutes of arrival, every time, so when something breaks overnight, someone has to be ready with a fast, safe fix immediately — not by morning. This is an individual contributor role, not a people-management position. You won’t have direct reports. What you will have is real responsibility: you’re the one who owns incident response at night, and you make sure the same process and communication standard that runs during the day holds up just as well at 2am. You’ll also train one Application Support team member to be your trusted backup at night — someone you can delegate real tasks to, not just someone shadowing you. What You’ll Own Incident command at night. When something breaks overnight, you declare it, triage it, and drive it to resolution — the same triage-first standard used during the day, applied consistently after hours. Platform monitoring, day and night. Watch the health of every module and catch problems early, whatever the hour. Cross-shift consistency. Make sure the process, tools, and communication flow used at night match what’s used during the day — no gaps, no separate “night version” of how things get handled. Training your night backup. Work with Jester to identify one Application Support team member as your trained backup for night coverage. Teach them to run real triage and delegate real tasks to them — not just observation. A close partnership with DevOps. Work directly with Jester and his team on keeping infrastructure stable and building better tools to catch problems automatically. Knowing when — and when not — to escalate further. Most problems get fixed at your level. For the rare cases that genuinely need more, you know exactly who to call and how. What Success Looks Like The platform stays healthy well over 99% of the time, day and night. Night incidents are handled fast and correctly — Jester never has to be pulled in personally to cover a night incident. Your trained backup can run night triage confidently on their own when needed. The daytime team never has to “catch up” on what happened overnight — communication is seamless across the shift change. What We’re Looking For Experience as an individual contributor in a technical support or incident response role — SaaS, platform operations, or similar. Comfortable owning a decision under pressure, alone, without a manager to check with in the moment. Able and willing to be the primary owner of incidents at night — this is the core of the role, not an occasional ask. Some hands-on comfort with basics like service restarts, log review, and ticketing systems (we use Jira). Deep DevOps expertise is not required — that’s Jester’s team; you need to know enough to apply a safe first fix and know when to hand off. Able to teach and delegate to a peer effectively, even without formal management authority. Clear, calm communicator — you’ll be updating customer-facing teams during live incidents. How We’ll Set You Up to Succeed The first 90 days follow a structured ramp: you’ll spend real time learning the platform and the team before you’re expected to run night incidents solo, then build up to full independent night ownership — including a trained backup — by the end of your first month. Full details are in the accompanying 90-Day Plan.

The platform is designed for demanding operational environments including Alarm Receiving Centres (ARCs), security monitoring centres, airports, corporate and industrial organisations, facilities management, manufacturing, local government, retail and other security-critical operations. We are now looking for an exceptional Senior Business Development Manager – New Business to play a key role in accelerating that growth. The Opportunity This is a new-business hunter role. We are looking for an ambitious, commercially aggressive and highly proactive Senior Business Development Manager who thrives on creating opportunities, opening doors and closing new business. This is not an account-management role , nor is it a position for someone who expects to rely on a steady flow of inbound leads. You will be responsible for building your own pipeline, identifying and targeting high-value prospective customers, engaging senior decision-makers and converting opportunities into new customers and recurring revenue. You will own the complete sales process from initial prospecting and discovery through product demonstration, proposal development, commercial negotiation and contract signature. You will have significant autonomy to develop the UK and European territory and will be expected to bring the energy, persistence and commercial discipline required to build a substantial new-business pipeline. Your objective is simple: create pipeline, win new logos and generate new recurring revenue. Key Responsibilities Own new-business development across the UK and European markets. Develop and execute a clear territory, vertical-market and target-account strategy. Identify and penetrate high-value prospective customers across GeminiSense’s target markets. Build and maintain a substantial qualified new-business pipeline. Generate your own opportunities through proactive outbound prospecting, direct outreach, networking, referrals, partners, industry events and targeted account development. Conduct consistent, high-quality prospecting into target organisations and named strategic accounts. Identify multiple routes into target organisations and develop relationships with key stakeholders and influencers. Engage confidently with senior decision-makers including CEOs, Managing Directors, Operations Directors, Security Directors, Control Room Managers, IT leaders and other relevant executives. Conduct effective discovery to understand each prospect’s operational, security, technical and commercial challenges. Translate customer requirements into compelling GeminiSense solutions with clearly defined operational and commercial benefits. Position and sell the broader GeminiSense platform across alarm and incident management, CCTV/video monitoring, lone-worker protection, IoT and sensor monitoring, communications, workflow and associated monitoring applications. Deliver compelling presentations, discovery sessions and product demonstrations, working with technical and product specialists where appropriate. Develop strong commercial proposals, business cases and ROI justifications. Own opportunities throughout the complete sales cycle, from initial contact through to contract signature. Maintain momentum throughout the sales process and proactively identify and overcome obstacles to closing. Develop relationships across multiple stakeholders within prospective customers to maximise the probability of successful conversion. Negotiate pricing, commercial terms and contracts. Consistently achieve or exceed agreed new ARR and revenue targets. Maintain a disciplined, accurate and appropriately weighted sales pipeline. Deliver reliable monthly and quarterly sales forecasts. Develop strategic relationships with technology partners, integrators and other organisations capable of generating new opportunities. Represent GeminiSense at relevant exhibitions, conferences, customer meetings and industry events throughout the UK and Europe. Monitor competitors, market developments and emerging opportunities across the security and monitoring technology markets. Provide structured customer and market feedback to Product, Marketing and Leadership teams. Strong evidence of personally generating significant sales pipeline rather than relying predominantly on marketing-generated or inbound leads. Experience selling complex B2B software, SaaS or technology solutions. A history of successfully developing new territories, opening strategic accounts and winning new logos. The confidence and ability to prospect consistently at senior and executive levels. Excellent discovery and consultative selling capabilities. Strong commercial instincts combined with a relentless focus on progressing and closing opportunities. Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder B2B sales cycles. Confidence negotiating significant commercial agreements. The ability to translate sophisticated technical capabilities into clear commercial and operational benefits. Strong presentation, communication and negotiation skills. Excellent pipeline-management and forecasting discipline. High levels of personal accountability, resilience and self-motivation. The ability to operate independently and effectively within a remote environment. A willingness to travel throughout the UK and Europe as required. Experience selling into large enterprise customers and complex operational environments would also be highly desirable. Additional European language skills and previous experience selling across multiple European territories would be advantageous. The Person We Are Looking For Someone Who Is Competitive. Persistent. Resilient. Commercial. Accountable. Driven. You should genuinely enjoy the challenge of opening doors that are initially closed. An unanswered email, unsuccessful call or initial rejection should not end your pursuit of an attractive account. You will identify another stakeholder, find another route into the organisation and continue developing the opportunity. You will be comfortable creating opportunities from a relatively cold territory and will not require a constant stream of marketing-generated leads to remain productive. You will be highly organised and disciplined in how you manage your territory, pipeline and opportunities, while maintaining the urgency required to drive deals forward. You will combine the persistence and determination of a true new-business hunter with the professionalism, credibility and consultative skills required to sell sophisticated technology into large and potentially mission-critical organisations. Above all, you will have a demonstrable history of turning prospecting activity into pipeline and pipeline into revenue. Key Performance Measures Will Include New Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) / revenue generated New customers and new logos won Qualified new-business pipeline created Pipeline coverage against sales target Target-account penetration Outbound prospecting effectiveness Qualified meetings and demonstrations generated Opportunity creation and conversion Sales-cycle progression Win rates Forecast accuracy Achievement against quarterly and annual sales targets The successful candidate will be expected to maintain sufficient qualified pipeline coverage to support consistent achievement of their revenue target. Base salary will therefore be dependent on the candidate’s experience, industry knowledge and, most importantly, their proven track record of winning new business and consistently delivering against sales targets. In addition to base salary, the position will include a highly competitive, uncapped commission plan directly linked to new-business performance. The commission structure will reward overachievement, with accelerators above 100% of target , ensuring that exceptional sales performance results in exceptional earnings. There will be no cap on earning potential for a salesperson who consistently exceeds their targets. Why GeminiSense? This is an opportunity to join GeminiSense at an exciting stage of its development and play a significant role in building its presence across the UK and Europe. GeminiSense combines the expertise and capabilities of Bold Communications Ltd and Innovative Business Software A/S , both part of the Valsoft Corporation portfolio. You will identify target markets, penetrate strategic accounts, establish new relationships, win new customers and help establish GeminiSense as a significant player within the UK and European security and monitoring technology markets. For the right salesperson, this role offers significant autonomy, market opportunity and uncapped earning potential, alongside the opportunity to make a highly visible contribution to the growth and success of GeminiSense.
